values.summary: Implemented bounded HTML Observatory Runtime v3 launch/start-stop-restart integration with a simple repo-native axum static server. CSMctl now starts the HTML Observatory through adl-observatory-static using configured cert/key/docroot/ports, owns a pid file, preserves Runtime/Observatory separation, and proves live Runtime restart plus Observatory root/index 200 behavior without Unity, AWS/public hosting, provider credentials, #341, #343, #84, #122, or #251 scope.
actual_changes: Added adl-runtime/src/bin/adl-observatory-static.rs, a tiny axum/axum-server HTTPS static-file server using dependencies already present in adl-runtime.

CSMctl observatory start now builds adl-observatory-static if needed, launches it with --daemon/--pid-file/--log-file, and reports success only when both HTTP 200 and a live pid-file process are present.
CSMctl observatory stop now terminates the exact Observatory pid-file process and removes Observatory pid/state files.
Removed the generated Python Observatory server, generated runner, and Observatory launchd plist path from CSMctl; no Node/http-server or OpenSSL s_server serving path is used.
Kept the Apache-style config boundary: cert path, key path, host, port list, document root, Runtime API base, pid/state/log paths, and separate Runtime versus Observatory startup.

The live validator now starts from a clean CSMctl-owned Observatory state, verifies root/index HTTP 200, probes every documented read/preflight/WSS route in scope, proves Runtime graceful stop/restart, and verifies post-restart CSMctl URL/base output is current.

Focused Rust tests pin the zero-new-dependency axum static-server contract, forbid old generated Python/Node/launchd helper names in CSMctl, and retain the exact live Runtime API label and 200-gating contracts.

actual_validation.purpose: Static contract proof for HTML Observatory Runtime v3 live labels, exact /v1/observatory HTTP 200 gating, zero-new-dependency axum static serving, CSMctl persisted-state reload, and post-restart validator assertions.

Focused Runtime API/WSS and CSMctl contract tests for exposed route coverage, strict live-data gating, axum static server root/index behavior, pid-owned startup, and no generated Python/Node/launchd Observatory helper regression.
Rust formatting check for the focused integration test and axum static server binary.
Whitespace and conflict-marker hygiene across #340 source, tests, validator, new axum static server, lifecycle card projections, and retained evidence.
Live local CSMctl/Runtime/Observatory proof for HTTP 200 startup gates, axum-served Observatory root/index, graceful Runtime stop cleanup, restart, and post-restart current URL/base reporting.
Typed lifecycle validation after final axum static-server evidence refresh.
